svg.title: Observer overhead per deployed task
svg.desc: Heatmap of median per-task observer token, latency, cost, and provider-call overhead for active carried and passive zero-carry observation methods, stratified by benchmark and agent model.
svg.text: Median across 56 held-out tasks per benchmark/model; observation calls only (agent-task calls excluded)
Cell shade is log-scaled within each metric. Exact input and output token counts are separate in the data files.

svg.text: Latency sums provider API response time: on-path delay for active probes; off-path time for provider-backed passive monitors.
Deterministic local runtime was not measured; zeros mean no provider calls. Dollar values are ledger estimates, not invoices.
